trustedNetworks.title: Trusted networks
trustedNetworks.switchWarning: Off by default. Only add networks you control, such as a kiosk's address.
trustedNetworks.switchOn: Login-free on the local network is on
trustedNetworks.switchOff: Login-free on the local network is off
trustedNetworks.switchOffNotice: Login-free on the local network is off: these rules sign nobody in until you turn it on.
trustedNetworks.help: A device on one of these networks is signed in as the chosen account, without a password.
trustedNetworks.proxyClosed: Never applies to connections from the internet, a proxy or Meshloom Remote.
trustedNetworks.none: No trusted network: every device signs in.
trustedNetworks.adminWarning: {{networks}}: a trusted network cannot sign in an administrator. Pick a member, viewer or kiosk account.
trustedNetworks.publicOrWideWarning: {{cidr}} is too wide or public: list only your local network or one device's address.
trustedNetworks.userDisabledNotice: The account of {{cidr}} is disabled: this rule never applies. Pick another account or remove the rule.
trustedNetworks.userMustChangeNotice: The account of {{cidr}} must change its password first: sign in once as that account, or pick another one.

securityNotice.title: Access security notice
securityNotice.trusted_admin_reduced_plugin_isolation: A trusted network signs in an administrator while plugins have reduced isolation: anyone on that network can run code on this machine.
securityNotice.trusted_loopback_or_gateway_public: A trusted network covers loopback or the Docker gateway: visitors from the internet could be signed in. Remove that rule.
securityNotice.trusted_network_public_or_wide: A trusted network is too wide or public: list only your local network or one device's address.

errors.auth_trusted_networks_invalid: Not a network, a network wider than /8 (IPv4) or /16 (IPv6), the same network twice, or more than 32 trusted networks: {{cidr}}
errors.auth_trusted_network_user_invalid: The network {{cidr}} names an account that does not exist or is disabled.
errors.auth_trusted_network_user_must_change: The network {{cidr}} names an account that must change its password first. Pick another account, or sign in once as that account.
errors.auth_trusted_network_overlaps_proxy: The network {{cidr}} overlaps the trusted proxy {{proxy}}: requests from a proxy are never signed in automatically.
errors.auth_trusted_network_loopback: The network {{cidr}} covers loopback: a local proxy or tunnel would bring every visitor from there.
errors.auth_trusted_network_overlaps_gateway: The network {{cidr}} covers the Docker gateway {{gateway}}: the internet could come through it.
errors.auth_trusted_network_user_admin: The network {{cidr}} cannot sign in an administrator. Pick a member, viewer or kiosk account.
errors.auth_lan_login_free_admin_rules: Not possible while a trusted network names an administrator ({{cidrs}}): change or remove those rules.
